summary: Snowboarder Sam Jones split from his party on Quandary Peak; a small wet avalanche in the Quandary Couloir knocked him off his feet and carried him ~1,000 ft toward the valley floor; he deployed his airbag, stayed on the surface, was not seriously injured, and walked out.
notes: Date pinned 2023-04-29 (Saturday) via the article's 'same day' reference to the 2023-04-29 Bald Mountain avalanche fatality (id 2694). No SAR deployment; self-rescued via airbag, walked out. Inserted run 901 (run-900 parked candidate, parent-opened).
